chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"If a ghoul appears to you, then give the adhan (call to prayer)."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the speaker of the hadith
key_terms.الْغُولُ: the ghoul; a frightening being mentioned in the report
key_terms.تَغَوَّلَتْ: appeared in the form of a ghoul or manifested as a ghoul
key_terms.فَأَذِّنُوا: then proclaim the adhan (call to prayer)

ai.seo_question: What should be done if a ghoul appears according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام instructs that if the ghoul appears, one should respond by giving the adhan. The hadith presents the adhan as a means of protection and response in the face of a frightening unseen presence.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.910 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"If a ghoul appears to you, then perform the adhan (call to prayer)."
